newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK 274.5 mln bills, rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK 274.5 mln bills, rates unchanged.

text.p: Volume shrank to 274.5 million kuna from 360 million in five- and 13-week bills, and rates were steady at a weekly auction of the Croatian central bank on Wednesday.
Five-week bills were issued on volume of 191.5 million kuna at 8.0 percent, unchanged for the past three weeks. The 13-week rate was also flat at 9.5 percent.
There were no bids for 26-week paper last issued three months ago.
Monday's reserve payment drained 3.4 billion kuna from the banking system, 20.1 million less than under the previous requirement, a bank official said. -- Zagreb nNewsroom, 385-1-4557075
